decisions.reason: It builds on established sports-flooring know-how and can still support project business, even if it is less central than the firm's design-led residential ranges.
A mobile arena floor is a narrow, project-based niche, and management would likely rationalize such specialist systems to focus resources on the core flooring portfolio.
As another mobile arena system, it appears especially exposed to portfolio consolidation if the firm does not need multiple similar specialist offers.
Chevron parquet fits the firm's premium, trend-led interior positioning very well and its home-page prominence suggests strong strategic relevance.
A squash court surface finish is highly specialized and sits furthest from the firm's stated growth direction toward style-oriented, natural-looking interior floors.
This accessory is relatively low-complexity, complements existing sports-floor installations, and is therefore more likely to be retained than actively withdrawn.
